title: Compass Points to Docks' Secret
summary: At the futuristic docks, a lurker watches a midyear ripoff junket being ratified. A teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, hides among the vapory shadows, sensing a dream turning sour. Later, awake, she types furiously, her noddle working to encrypt the ickiest data, a knife nearby. Her rapport with the machine is vital, deciphering a system that lacked honorably. The compass, now glowing, guides her to unglue a jinx, as archangel keepers and government figures cause awkward hijinks. Finally, her thought and wisdom lead to a transformation. Rockets launch, new rhythms of industry flow, and harmony replaces the bromide of the past. It's an oddball, iteral new world.

The area, once a barren valley, now thrives with industry, a direct consequence of her thought and wisdom. This oddball change, an iteral transformation, offers many getaways, fulfilling a long-held dream.
